name: ecom-marketplace-demo
description: 🛍️ A polished demo e-commerce marketplace frontend showcasing modern UI, smooth shopping flows, and premium client-ready features.

paragraphs: A polished, high-performance frontend showcase of a next-generation online shopping experience. This demo was created to help businesses, founders, and decision-makers visualize what their customers could experience when working with us to design or upgrade their marketplace. It highlights sleek design, intuitive flows, and premium features — all of which can be customized to fit your unique brand, goals, and audience.
Think of this as your preview window: a chance to explore what’s possible before investing in a custom build.
